service-call.name: ironstone.comms.MailSettingsServices.save#AccountConnection
service-call.in-map: {emailAccountId:emailAccountId, emailAddress:emailAddress, displayName:displayName, accountKindEnumId:accountKindEnumId, storeKind:storeKind, storeSecurity:storeSecurity, storeHost:storeHost, storePort:storePort, smtpHost:smtpHost, smtpPort:smtpPort, smtpSecurity:smtpSecurity, mailUsername:mailUsername, mailPassword:mailPassword, smtpUsername:(smtpUsername ?? null), smtpPassword:(smtpPassword ?? null), gatewayDelivery:(gatewayDelivery == 'Y' || gatewayDelivery == true)}

actions.script: const L = (text) => text.length > 255 ? text : ec.l10n.localize(text) gateway = false let settings = storeHost ? {storeKind: storeKind, storeSecurity: storeSecurity, storeHost: storeHost, storePort: storePort, smtpHost: smtpHost, smtpPort: smtpPort, smtpSecurity: smtpSecurity, mailUsername: mailUsername, smtpUsername: smtpUsername || '', source: source || 'guess'} : null hasSmtpPassword = false hasPassword = false oauthSignedIn = false signedInAddress = null let kind = accountKindEnumId let address = emailAddress let suggestion = null let accountProvider = null let opened = false if (emailAccountId) { const detail = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.MailSettingsServices.get#MailAccountDetail').parameter('emailAccountId', emailAccountId).call() if (!ec.message.hasError() && detail?.found) { opened = true hasPassword = detail.server?.hasPassword === true hasSmtpPassword = detail.server?.hasSmtpPassword === true if (!settings && detail.server) settings = Object.assign({source: 'saved'}, detail.server) // the outgoing user saved with the account, when the URL names none else if (settings && !settings.smtpUsername && detail.server?.smtpUsername) settings.smtpUsername = detail.server.smtpUsername if (!address) address = detail.account?.emailAddress kind = detail.account?.accountKindEnumId || kind accountProvider = detail.server?.oauthProviderEnumId || null oauthSignedIn = detail.signIn?.isOAuth === true && detail.signIn.signedIn === true signedInAddress = detail.server?.mailUsername || address } } // hosted, or shared with no incoming server: the gateway delivers. No lookup and no password. // A personal account with no server (the demo mailbox) stays on the server form. const deliveredKind = kind === 'EakHosted' || kind === 'EakShared' gateway = (delivery === 'gateway' && (deliveredKind || !opened)) || (opened && !settings && deliveredKind) if (gateway) { hasAddress = !!address if (!hasAddress) return if (!deliveredKind) kind = 'EakHosted' connect = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId || '', emailAddress: address, displayName: displayName || '', accountKindEnumId: kind, gatewayDelivery: 'Y'} return } if (!settings && address) { suggestion = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.MailSettingsServices.suggest#MailServer').parameter('emailAddress', address).call()?.suggestion || null if (suggestion) settings = suggestion } hasAddress = !!address if (!hasAddress) return settings = settings || {} const provider = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.MailSettingsServices.get#MailProvider').parameters({emailAddress: address, storeHost: settings.storeHost || null}).call()?.provider || null // the sign-in with Google or Microsoft, where this server is set up for the provider the mail is at oauthChoice = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.MailSettingsServices.get#OAuthChoice').parameters({emailAddress: address, storeHost: settings.storeHost || null, oauthProviderEnumId: oauthProvider || accountProvider || null}).call()?.choice || null oauthConfigured = oauthChoice?.configured === true providerLabel = oauthChoice?.providerLabel || null signInIntro = oauthConfigured ? ec.resource.expand('Sign in with your ${name} account in the window that opens: we never see your password, and no app password is needed.', '', {name: providerLabel}) : null signedInText = oauthSignedIn ? ec.resource.expand('Signed in with ${name} as ${address}', '', {name: providerLabel || L('the provider'), address: signedInAddress}) : null signInOffText = oauthChoice && !oauthConfigured ? ec.resource.expand('Sign-in with ${name}, which needs no app password, is not set up on this server: an administrator can set it up. Until then, use an app password.', '', {name: providerLabel}) : null const SOURCES = {provider: L('We know the server settings of your provider.'), autoconfig: L('Your mail provider publishes these server settings.'), ispdb: L('These server settings are from the Thunderbird database of mail providers.'), srv: L('These server settings are from the DNS records of your domain.'), saved: L('These are the server settings saved with the account.'), guess: L('These server settings are guesses from your domain: check them against your provider\'s help page for mail apps (IMAP and SMTP).'), failed: L('The server settings could not be looked up just now, so these are guesses: check them against your provider\'s help page.')} const sourceKey = SOURCES[settings.source] ? settings.source : 'guess' sourceText = SOURCES[sourceKey] isGuess = sourceKey === 'guess' || sourceKey === 'failed' providerName = provider?.providerName || null appPassword = provider?.appPassword === true helpText = provider?.helpText || null helpUrl = provider?.helpUrl || null helpLinkText = provider?.helpLinkText || L('Where to make it') noteText = provider?.noteText || null warningText = suggestion?.warningText || (provider?.unsupported ? provider.helpText : null) passwordTitle = appPassword ? L('App password') : L('Password') passwordCaption = oauthSignedIn ? L('No password is needed: the account signs in with its provider.') : hasPassword ? L('Saved. Leave it empty to keep it, or enter a new one.') : (appPassword ? ec.resource.expand('The app password you made for ${name}; it is kept encrypted and never shown again.', '', {name: providerName}) : L('Your email password; it is kept encrypted and never shown again.')) connect = {emailAccountId: emailAccountId || '', emailAddress: address, displayName: displayName || '', accountKindEnumId: kind || 'EakExternal', storeKind: settings.storeKind || 'imap', storeSecurity: settings.storeSecurity || 'ssl', storeHost: settings.storeHost || '', storePort: settings.storePort || '', smtpHost: settings.smtpHost || '', smtpPort: settings.smtpPort || '', smtpSecurity: settings.smtpSecurity || 'starttls', mailUsername: settings.mailUsername || address, mailPassword: '', smtpUsername: settings.smtpUsername || '', smtpPassword: ''} smtpCaption = settings.smtpUsername && hasSmtpPassword ? L('The outgoing server signs in as its own user, with the password saved for it: leave the password empty to keep it.') : (settings.smtpUsername ? L('Your provider\'s outgoing server signs in as another user: check it and enter its password. It is tried before it is saved.') : L('Only when your provider\'s outgoing server signs in as another user than the incoming one: its user name and password, tried before they are saved. Empty: the same sign-in as above.'))

label.text: The mail gateway delivers mail for this address. There is no mail server to sign in to, and no password.
A tag after a plus sign still arrives here: sales+news@example.com goes to sales@example.com.
Next adds the account, paused until the last step. Nothing is signed in to.
